pages.text: The $(bold)Sequencer$() reads a Filled DNA Strand and combines it with a Base Extract to produce a $(bold)specific strain extract$(). This is the final step in the DNA engineering chain before using the Mutator.$(br)$(br)$(bold)Inputs:$()$(br)• Filled DNA Strand (from Synthesizer)$(br)• Base Extract$(br)$(br)$(bold)Output:$() A specific strain's extract$(br)$(br)The Sequencer checks that the 3 embedded reagents in the DNA Strand match a known recipe, then produces the matching extract. No guessing — the output is deterministic based on the reagents.

pages.title: Full DNA Chain
pages.text: $(bold)Step 1:$() Extractor + Hemp Seeds → DNA Strand$(br)$(bold)Step 2:$() Synthesizer + DNA Strand + 3 Reagents → Filled DNA Strand$(br)$(bold)Step 3:$() Sequencer + Filled DNA Strand + Base Extract → Strain Extract$(br)$(bold)Step 4:$() Mutator + Any Seeds + Strain Extract + 300 mB Hemp Oil → Strain Seeds$(br)$(br)See each strain's entry for the exact 3 reagents to put in the Synthesizer.
